title: Lesson 39 - Predictive AI Trade-offs: Score, Prediction, and Recommendation, Discovery, and Conversation Insights
description: Understand what predictive AI tools are available in Agentforce Sales.

questions.question: A sales VP wants the system to tell reps which single action to take next on an at risk renewal, not just a probability. Which capability answers the requirement?
options: An Einstein Next Best Action strategy built in Flow on top of a prediction
A validation rule on the Opportunity
questions.explanation: A recommendation is produced by a strategy layer that converts a prediction into an action, which is what Einstein Next Best Action does. A score or a sync feature does not produce advice.

questions.question: A consultant needs a prediction for renewal likelihood, a target with no shipped scorer, and the sales leaders want to see which factors drive it. What fits?
options: Enable Einstein Lead Scoring on the Account object
Use Opportunity Score as a proxy
Build a report with a formula field
Build an Einstein Discovery story and model on a dataset with renewal as the outcome, then deploy the prediction field
questions.explanation: Einstein Discovery builds a model for a target of your choosing and surfaces the drivers, which is exactly what a custom outcome with an explanation requirement needs.

questions.question: A manager asks what unlocks coaching evidence from recorded sales calls, including talk ratio and competitor mentions.
options: Einstein Conversation Insights, deployed alongside a recording consent process
A prompt template in Prompt Builder
questions.explanation: Conversation Insights records and transcribes calls and surfaces talk ratios and competitor mentions, and recording consent has to be handled wherever it is deployed.
